purpose: Teach: アトリエ/バグダッド/整形/雛/赤十字/ダンボール/グアム/スーパーマーケット

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが、お家にアトリエを作りたいって
lines.en: Sho, your father wants to build an atelier in the house.
lines.style: Calm, informative tone. Sharing news gently. Slight pause between sentences, as if giving him space to absorb. Warm but measured—a mother thinking aloud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ニュースでバグダッドのお話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom, I heard about Baghdad on the news.
lines.style: Sudden, curious attention. The words come quickly—a child making a connection he needs to share. Not fully understanding the weight, but feeling it. Direct eye contact.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが整形外科に通っていらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather goes to the orthopedist regularly.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery, no alarm in the voice. She's explaining something she's noticed, something ordinary to adults. Steady, informative.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、雛人形飾るのお手伝いするよ
lines.en: Mom, I can help you set up the Hina dolls.
lines.style: Bright offer, eager to be useful. Small chest lifted. The words tumble out—he's proud to think of this. Seeks approval but doesn't demand it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが赤十字に寄付してらっしゃるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your father donates to the Red Cross.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost didactic. She's connecting pieces for him. Not explaining, but stating something she wants him to understand. Gentle authority.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ダンボールでロボット作ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I made a robot out of cardboard.
lines.style: Proud but not loud. He's showing something he's made. The statement is simple and direct—the accomplishment speaks for itself. Quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと一緒にグアム旅行に行きましょう
lines.en: Sho, why don't we go to Guam with your father?
lines.style: Warm invitation, softly offered. She's extending something hopeful. Gentle rise at the end—she wants him to want this. Present and tender.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ママとスーパーマーケットで卵を選んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I helped you pick the eggs at the supermarket.
lines.style: Bright recall, happy to remind her of a shared moment. The words are quick and warm—he's holding onto something ordinary that mattered to him. Direct, eager for her to remember too.
